verdict.rationale: The official Angular repository points developers to an upgrade guide for "the best way to upgrade your project" [angular-gh-3]. The official CLI ships an update command that "updates your workspace and its dependencies" [angular-docs-15], which gives a first-party, tool-assisted migration path. The AngularJS-to-Angular 2 compatibility complaint [angular-comm-4] concerns a historical rewrite and does not contradict the existence of the current guide. missing for 10: no in-depth content from the upgrade guide itself (e.g. version-by-version steps or automated migrations), no independent or hands-on corroboration that following the guide works smoothly.
